text:
hana: Dropped a compact roles + batched-invite flow prototype in Figma: https://figma.com/file/NEWFLOW_2198 — main goals: reduce clicks to preview effective permissions, clarify SSO wording, and make audit filters shareable across pages.

hana: Also added a small "copy view" link on the audit panel that creates a short URL. Curious if folks are okay with URL params vs session state.

leo: Looked at the mock — compact rows are neat. Request: swap multiple interactive chips for one inline expander per row (chevron) that reveals a 1-line permission summary and actions. Keeps tab stops low.

samir: +1 on single expander. For keyboard users use a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Example in notes: `button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="perm-42" aria-label="Open permissions for Data Viewer"`. When expanded, announce short SR text: "Data Viewer: read models, run queries."

frida: SSO copy nit: current label "Enforce SSO" is terse and confusing. Propose: "Require SSO for org sign-in" with helper text below: "Does not sign out active sessions; new sign-ins will require your IdP." Put helper into aria-describedby.

leo: Also the invite CTA needs to surface role application. If an admin selects roles before sending, CTA should read "Invite and assign roles" or dynamically include count: "Invite 4 users and assign roles". Prevents surprise.

samir: On the invite drawer focus flow I found a trap: open invite drawer, expand a role preview, then tab goes out of the drawer header. We should trap focus inside the active overlay and ensure Esc closes the topmost overlay. QA ticket recommended.

qa-bot: QA repro steps attached: reproducible on Chrome/Win, Safari/Mac. Logged QA-9011. Steps: Open org settings > Audit log > apply filter > go to Roles > open invite drawer > expand role > Tab until focus escapes. Filters also reset when returning to Audit log.

frida: Regarding the audit share link, prefer URL params (shallow) because back/forward will work and links are bookmarkable. But please avoid exposing PII — use opaque actor IDs. Add a small toast after copying: "Link copied — filters encoded".

samir: Mobile fallback: no hover, so tapping the chevron should expand an inline summary. Also ensure expansions aren't too tall on small screens. Consider collapsing after a short timeout if user navigates away.

leo: Accessibility checklist for this change: explicit on/off labels for SSO toggle, visible focus outline at 2px, aria-live polite for summaries, single tabbable expander per row, Esc behavior documented. I'll add to the Figma notes.

hana: Action items:
- update SSO label to "Require SSO for org sign-in" + helper text and aria-describedby (frida)
- replace many chips with one accessible expander per row (leo + design)
- dynamic invite CTA that reflects selected users/roles (leo)
- trap keyboard focus in invite drawer and close overlays in reverse order (eng ticket, link QA-9011)
- persist audit filters in URL params with opaque IDs + copy-link toast (samir + eng)
- mobile expander behavior (design)

design-bot: Created ticket PROD-5766: "Compact roles: expander + SSO copy + audit share link" and assigned to design + eng-ux.

hana: Can design upload a single compact screen with aria notes and the copy-link toast by EOD so eng can estimate? Thanks all.
